question: Which C1 failures of the fixed Qwen2.5-7B can external compensation recover, and which stay wrong even with the gold passage (capability boundary)?
role: measurement only: an upper bound on evidence-side compensation. Never a product component; no product choice, threshold or selector is fitted on these results.
data_exception: For these runs only, gold passage IDs (not gold answers) reach the GPU host, as ordinary context passage IDs with no marker; passage text comes from the NQ Train corpus there. Gold answers stay local for scoring. The 2026-10-08 preliminary C3 runs used the same kind of input.

set.name: quality sweep 6,000 (Validation; already used for every sweep choice)
set.not_used: confirm 2,440 and team Test 11,114 are not run

inputs.c1_top5: route-1 sweep records (evidence of the frozen C1 run, prefill full)
inputs.gold_passage: annotation_reference.gold_passage_id of the team delivery nq_train_delivery_20261017 (local only)

levels.L1: route 1 (B): P3-20 on routed items, C1 otherwise (existing sweep answers)
levels.L2_any: any of C1 and the 18 L2 retrieval contexts is correct (selection upper bound over real retrieval; existing answers)
levels.L3: gold passage first, then C1's Top-5 without the gold passage in C1 order, first four; equal to C1's Top-5 when the gold passage is C1's first

generation: scripts/l2_generate.py unchanged (build_c1_prompt over corpus passage text, the shared Qwen generator, 64 answer tokens), --data-role validation

answer.primary: the generated answer, stripped: what the 7B reads from the evidence

scoring: judge-assisted correctness with the team judge; labels reused by (sample, answer string); C1 answers never judged before are judged in the same batch
analysis: first level that fixes each C1 failure: L1, L2, L2_any, L3, L4, or none (capability boundary)
the same by gold position: C1 Top-1, Top-5, BGE top 20, BGE top 100, beyond
how well runtime signals separate boundary failures: stage-1 failure probability, and the adaptive-selection disagreement over C1 and 8 contexts (answer groups, largest share)
C1-correct items: how often L3 / L4 break a correct answer
